description: California Energy Consumption Dashboards is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Access is provided through the link to the following dashboards that display historical statewide electricity and natural gas consumption data and trends. Highlights include consumption broken down by planning area, agency, and sector. Data is derived from the Quarterly Fuels and Energy Report. 1. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Natural Gas. Its keywords are energy consumption, electricity consumption, natural gas consumption. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
